Voidflame-Resistant Hide is needed to obtain the Felreaver Deathcycle during Horrific Visions Revisited. It is need to craft the Voidflame Wheel. Hides can be found in Wyrmbane's chest (Trade District) and Geyarah's chest (Valley of Wisdom). The hide also requires: * 1x Tentacle Spokes — Wyrmbane's chest (Trade District) and Geyarah's chest (Valley of Wisdom) * 6x Entropy Enhancer — Khaz Algar engineering This makes one wheel, and two are required.

Two Voidflame Wheels are required to make the Felreaver Deathcycle from Horrific Visions Revisited. Each wheel requires: * 1x Voidflame-Resistant Hide — Wyrmbane's chest (Trade District) and Geyarah's chest (Valley of Wisdom) * 1x Tentacle Spokes — Wyrmbane's chest (Trade District) and Geyarah's chest (Valley of Wisdom) * 6x Entropy Enhancer — Khaz Algar engineering

Voidfire Deathcycle Frame is the frame of the Felreaver Deathcycle. Players first come across it with at least one mask active in the Dwarven District of the Vision of Stormwind during Horrific Visions Revisited. Attack it but don't deplete it of health to have Haymar the Devout launch the bike forward. Defeat Haymar, then interact with the Voidfire Deathcycle Frame to send it to the Dornogal base camp. If the bike runs out of health before Haymar launches it off, players will not be able to interact with the frame. Finish the vision, successfully or not, then check in at base camp south of the Coreway in Dornogal.

Volatile Plague Bombs are oozes summoned by Doctor Ickus at the Forge of Pestilence in Plaguefall on Mythic difficulty. After 15 seconds, they will explode. In order to cause Doctor Ickus to summon these, Volatile Substances have to be picked up prior to the fight and thrown into each of the green alchemical pools in the area, causing the pools to become purple. The first Volatile Substance can be picked up from the table near the first pool on the right from the entrance to the area. Each subsequent one will spawn next to a pool that has become purple. Once all of them are purple, the boss fight can be started and Doctor Ickus will spawn these oozes instead of the regular Plague Bombs.

The Voronei are a faction of draenei led by Rebel Captain , who disagreed with Velen's guidance to lay low and stay out of trouble in order to survive. Instead, she felt that the only way to escape the Burning Legion was to fight them directly and eradicate their forces. Knowing that Velen wouldn't budge, Dirdra formed the Voronei and recruited many like-minded draenei to join her aboard her ship: . Even though they're outnumbered, the Voronei's cunning coordination gives them a valuable tool against the Legion. Wago.io (or just Wago) is a large WeakAuras and AddOn hosting website that launched in July 2016. The site entered beta later in the month on July 30th with support for ElvUI import strings. On 15 June 2020, Wago was acquired by Method. On 23 February 2021, Wago expanded to add support for hosting AddOns on the site along with a new app for AddOn management. In February 2022, Wago partnered up with WowUp, allowing WowUp's manager to manage and auto-update AddOns available from Wago.
